scope: Exact single-location Pauli signatures for three joint Z_source Z_target^-1 cats, full independent source/target CSS postselection, inter-gadget idles, source MX readout flips. Source initially arbitrary clean logical state, target clean |+_L>; parity label s=a-b and source Fourier label t imply correction X^s Z^t in time order (Z^t X^s operator). Decoder uses ideal target terminal syndromes and source destructive classical syndrome; final correction noiseless. Erasure combinatorics certifies source X-logical readout on up to3 erased positions and target X logical outside up to4 erased positions (target full recovery also needs Z; gX=gZ and logicals proportional). Not noisy encoding or active recovery, combined faults or full factory threshold.
